title: Kissed Citrus Xinjiang Pork Bao
description: A bright, citrus-infused Xinjiang pork bao with a glassy jelly glaze and Thai sweet basil drizzle, perfect for a hangover cure and high‑protein snack.
instructions: Slice pork belly into 1.5 cm thick strips and season with salt and pepper.
In a bowl mix dark soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, honey, orange juice, citrus zest, caster sugar, minced garlic, and sesame oil; marinate pork for 30 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high, sear pork strips until browned, about 3 minutes per side.
Transfer pork to a pot, add 200 ml water, bring to simmer, cover and braise for 45 minutes until tender.
While pork braises, combine juice, sugar, gelatin, and 50 ml hot water in a small saucepan; whisk and heat until gelatin dissolves.
Add fresh basil leaves to the glaze, simmer for 1 minute, then strain to remove solids.
Remove pork, shred with forks, and return to pot, stirring to coat with the glaze.
Steam bao wrappers in a steamer basket over boiling water for 3 minutes, then divide pork filling into 4 equal portions.
Place each portion on a wrapper, fold into bao shape, seal edges, and steam again for 2 minutes.
Serve bao hot, drizzle remaining glaze over the top and garnish with extra basil leaves.
